specification_assumptions.scope: Recheck.sound's model of how a compiled object is loaded and called: IxCC.X86.Driver (IxCC/X86/Driver.lean), IxCC.X86.Linked and IxCC.X86.LinkedAt (IxCC/X86/Linked.lean), IxCC.X86.ByteAgree (IxCC/X86/ByteAgree.lean), ObjectEval.call with ELF.symbol? specification_assumptions.assumption: Running a test executable that X86.Exe.writeFor accepted, with the test shell's frame, for an object Recheck.run accepted behaves, at the observation the host reads back, as X86.Linked.call does on the Driver that describes the process. The Linux loader maps the file at 0x400000 and its zero-filled segments as its checked program headers say, so the object's text is at base and one private, zero-filled region of size bytes is at region (page-aligned; 8-aligned, at least 4 KiB and below 2^63 for a run cx_init accepts); the host stores the stack budget at region + 16 (ctx - 48) through the shell before cx_init, and the region's other bytes before the first call are the loader's zeros; the call stack (the budget + 56 bytes below sp and the return slot) lies in the zero-filled stack segment, with nothing mapped below it, and the region is a zero-filled segment of its own, one unmapped page above the stack segment, with nothing mapped right below it or past its last page. For each input the shell calls cx_init(region, size, budget) and then the root's export, each by a direct call rel32 to the export's offset in the object's symbol table (ELF.symbol?, which the executable check reads back from the file), with rsp at the shell's fixed call top less the return slot, the return address after the object's text, rdi = region and the arguments in rsi, rdx, rcx, r8, r9 (zero beyond), sentinels in rbx, rbp and r12 to r15 and any values in the other registers and flags, and without touching the region between cx_init and the root's return (it reads or writes the region only for the host, between calls); the second call starts from the bytes the first left. The observation is the root call's rax:rdx: status 0 with the value read back at the root's first-order type by Rt.readback over the region from region + 16 with fuel (limit - region) / 8 (an independent decoder decodes it too, and the two must agree), other statuses as the wrapper's resource failures. Arguments of 2^64 or more cannot be passed and are a resource failure in the model. The model maps only the region and the call stack; the process maps more (its file, the shell's 256 bytes above the call top, the initial stack, the vDSO). That a run the model shows non-faulting is the process's run, or the process stops on a fault, and writes nothing outside the model's mapping is a theorem of the byte machine for every table row and control row (X86.ByteAgree: step_agree and run_agree, agreement or fault; step_frame and run_frame, the frame), so it is no longer part of this assumption; the byte machine being the processor is x86-v0-local-semantics. The test shell's code, the Linux calls it makes (prctl, seccomp, read from descriptor 0, write to 1 and 2, exit) and the host's Lean code are trusted test code here, as the C runtime driver, the C compiler, the C library and the system linker's symbol resolution were until X1, when the C driver was deleted. Driver.Ok, the numeric contract, is a hypothesis of Recheck.sound, not part of this assumption. For a same-arena session, X86.DriverSession specifies one initialization, an exact-arity numeric root call, complete observation before drop, then cx_drop with the original owned result word passed unchanged in rsi under the .word representation. The next call starts from the bytes left by release; only the standard return-slot setup is repeated. The reuse session follows that protocol through the test shell and makes no allocator metadata writes after initialization. This protocol description is not an assumption of ownership from readback: ownership must be supplied by the physical Returned invariant. General repeated-session adequacy, including source-GoesWrong qualification and the whole-call budget-word frame needed for backend reentry, is not asserted by the single-call theorem.
specification_assumptions.proof_effect: Recheck.sound, object_refines, back_refines and compile_sound_linked/compile_safe_linked/compile_diverges_linked are theorems about X86.Linked (ObjectEval over the parsed object bytes and the byte machine), using only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. Their reading as statements about the native executable is conditional on this assumption, on x86-v0-local-semantics (the byte machine is the processor) and on the loader mapping the written executable as its checked program headers say (the object's text byte for byte, as ELFRead parses it, which the executable check compares). No Lean axiom or native symbol is introduced; the test shell and the host are untrusted test code that this entry describes, and production artifacts do not depend on it. The bounded RC counterparts in IxCC.Recheck.RcReplay have the same accepted-run and Driver.Ok premises and retain source GoesWrong. Their result view observes complete constructor trees. Returned.release_public executes the actual public drop from the exact owned output token and restores allocator readiness; HeapState.reclaimed establishes complete logical reclamation with zero external owners; recycled_entry reuses the reached heap without initialization. drop_sim_linked proves the emitted raw-word drop ABI under the existing EntryBase contract. specification_assumptions.assumption: The shell's code is not assumed: X86.Exe.Process.shell_sound proves, for every file X86.Exe.Machine.writeChecked accepts, that the generic shell realises the session model (X0-P). What is assumed is the platform the theorem takes as hypotheses, exactly three specification modules, one platform fact, and the environment they describe. (1) Process.Loaded (IxCC/X86/Exe/Process/Loaded.lean): the kernel's ELF loader and initial stack (System V gABI, Program Loading; x86-64 psABI, Initial Stack and Register State): rip is the entry the checked header gives (the shell's first byte), the file's bytes are at 0x400000, and rsp points at argc, argv[0] to argv[argc - 1] and a null pointer, argv[i] for i >= 1 pointing at the bytes of the i-th argument and a NUL, every word and byte of the block outside the frame's zero-filled segments; nothing is assumed of permissions, the zero fill, other registers or the flags. (2) Process.Syscall (IxCC/X86/Exe/Process/Syscall.lean): the syscall(2) convention (the number in rax, the arguments in rdi, rsi, rdx, r10, r8, r9, the result in rax, rcx and r11 written by the instruction, every other register and the memory unchanged on return), prctl(PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS, ...) and seccomp(SECCOMP_SET_MODE_FILTER, 0, prog) returning any result, write(fd, buf, count) recording the count bytes at buf and returning a byte count no larger than count when non-negative (else -errno), and exit (system call 60) ending the process; any other call, or prctl and seccomp with other arguments, may do anything. (3) Process.Step (IxCC/X86/Exe/Process/Step.lean): the processor is the byte machine (x86-v0-local-semantics) fetching from the file, which the loader maps read-and-execute (so a store of the process there faults), with the system call where the byte decoder decodes nothing and the bytes are 0F 05; where the byte machine does not say what the processor does, nothing is promised: where the decoder decodes nothing and the bytes are not 0F 05 (which includes every rip outside the file) and where the byte machine stops on a condition over a flag it leaves undefined, the process may step to any state with any system call or none, or end. None of these is a fault of the processor: undecoded bytes are in general instructions it runs, a branch on an undefined flag goes one way, and outside the file it runs whatever is mapped there. (4) A memory fault or a divide error ends the process with no further system call: the processor raises an exception, the kernel sends SIGSEGV, SIGBUS or SIGFPE, and its default action applies, no handler being installed (execve resets handlers; the kernel forces the default action of a fault's signal that is ignored or blocked; the shell installs none, its only system calls before a call the model shows stuck being prctl, seccomp, write and exit, which shell_sound proves). (5) The environment: the specifications describe the kernel's own behaviour for a process nothing outside it interferes with. (a) No tracer is attached: a ptrace tracer can change system-call results, registers and memory and suppress a fault's signal (strace -e inject=exit:error=EPERM makes exit return, and the shell's exit block, which jumps back to itself, then repeats the call, a trace no theorem allows). (b) No seccomp filter or supervisor installed by an ancestor changes what write, exit, prctl or seccomp do or return: a filter answering exit with an error makes it return as in (a), and a user-notification supervisor answering write with more than its count makes the report loop step past its message and write bytes no theorem allows (a filter that kills the process does no harm). (c) No other process writes the process's memory or the file it is mapped from: such a writer changes the bytes the shell writes or the instructions the processor runs. (d) The process has one thread: execve leaves one and the shell creates none; with another, memory could change between instructions, and system call 60, which ends only the calling thread, would not end the process. Nothing else is assumed by this entry: the theorems allow a memory fault at any access, after which the trace ends, say nothing of progress, and claim nothing past the point where the source step goes wrong; a state where Process.Step promises nothing is reached only past that point (machine_exe_unspecified).

The codec still decodes ingress; a defect can make ingress reject a closure or read a different program than ix compiled, which Recheck.run then checks as given, and the kernel front end checks IxCC's reading against the kernel's (IxCC.Src.KernelFront.Reading). native_decide_sites.ruling: A default-argument proof in the signature (h : length < 2 ^ System.Platform.numBits := by native_decide) of a definition generic over a hasher backend. The tactic runs only where a caller omits the argument, and adds a native-evaluation axiom (Lean.ofReduceBool) to that caller alone: in Blake3.lean, HasherOps.hash, hashKeyed, hashDeriveKey and Sponge.ratchet. Blake3.Pure calls none of them (this closure's two files are hashed, so that stays reviewed). That IxCC calls none of them rests on two checks: project_entrypoints, IxCC's names under Blake3 being exactly Blake3.Pure.hash (a reading of the text, which a name reached without spelling Blake3 would escape), and the exact axiom fences, which are what show that no fenced IxCC theorem depends on a native-evaluation axiom (IxCC.Ixon.Address.blake3Pure among them, at [propext, Quot.sound]).

A default-argument proof in the signature (_h : ¬label.isEmpty := by native_decide) of the sponge's constructor, generic over a hasher backend. It runs only where a caller omits the argument; no declaration of this closure calls Sponge.init. That IxCC does not rests on project_entrypoints (IxCC's names under Blake3 are exactly Blake3.Pure.hash; a reading of the text) and on the exact axiom fences, which show that no fenced IxCC theorem depends on a native-evaluation axiom.

A default-argument proof in the signature (h_len_bound : 2 * BLAKE3_OUT_LEN + length.toNat < 2 ^ System.Platform.numBits := by native_decide) of the sponge's output, generic over a hasher backend. It runs only where a caller omits the argument; no declaration of this closure calls Sponge.squeeze. That IxCC does not rests on project_entrypoints (IxCC's names under Blake3 are exactly Blake3.Pure.hash; a reading of the text) and on the exact axiom fences, which show that no fenced IxCC theorem depends on a native-evaluation axiom.

lean_dependencies.semantics_assumed: Blake3.Pure.hash (Blake3/Pure.lean) is a total Lean function computing the standard unkeyed 32-byte BLAKE3 digest of exactly its input bytes over a checked canonical tree; IxCC computes every address with it (IxCC.Ixon.Address.blake3 is Address.blake3Pure), compiled natively like the rest of IxCC. Its result type (Blake3Hash, BLAKE3_OUT_LEN) comes from the package's root module Blake3.lean, which also holds the interface the package's native backends implement (HasherOps, Sponge); IxCC uses neither the interface nor a backend. Conformance to the BLAKE3 standard is tested, not proved. Collision resistance is not assumed globally: canonical-address identity is conditional on an explicit pairwise Address.Blake3NoCollision premise.
lean_dependencies.proof_effect: No native interface and no axiom beyond the standard three: IxCC.Ixon.Address.blake3Pure is fenced at [propext, Quot.sound] (IxCCTests/Fences/Compile.lean), and every IxCC theorem whose definitions hash, the compiler's composition theorems among them, keeps its exact fence on the standard axioms. The three native_decide sites of Blake3.lean are admitted only as listed: each is a default-argument proof that adds a native-evaluation axiom to the caller that omits the argument, and no fenced IxCC theorem lists such an axiom.
